blocks.title: Logistic regression
blocks.text: Logistic regression haan ya nahi wale nateeje ki pesh-goi karta hai. Theek adad ki bajaye 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan imkan deta hai: P = 1 / (1 + e^-(b0 + b1 x)), jahan e natural logarithm ki bunyad, b0 intercept (x = 0 par log-odds) aur b1 x ki har ikai par log-odds ki tabdeeli hai.

blocks.caption: Parhai ke ghante aur exam nataij

blocks.text: 0.85 ka andaza pass hone ka 85% imkan hai. Kitab b0 = 1 aur b1 = 0.6 farz karti hai. In qeematon se 5 ghante par P = 1 / (1 + e^-4), taqreeban 0.98, aur 4 ghante par 1 / (1 + e^-3.4), taqreeban 0.97. Kitab 0.83 aur 0.73 chhapti hai, jo 1 ghante aur 0 ghante ki qeematein hain. Yeh farz shuda coefficients data par bhi poore nahi utarte, kyunke 1 ghanta parh kar fail hone wale ke liye bhi pass ka andaza dete hain. Is data par baitha model manfi intercept rakhega, to us ka imkan 3 aur 4 ghante ke darmiyan 0.5 paar karega.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: customers banam earnings ke paanch nuqte line earnings = 100 + 40 x customers par, 22 customers par Rs 980 ki prediction aur chhatay din ka asal nuqta 1,250. Oopar daen: 1 se 6 ghante parhai ke pass/fail nuqton par S-shakal imkan ka curve. Neeche baen: paanch students ke Math aur English scores do K-means clusters mein, markaz x se. Neeche daen: model banane ke paanch qadam.
blocks.caption: Linear regression, logistic regression aur K-means (topic 5.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Phal ke stall ka data bilkul line earnings = 100 + 40 x customers par hai, to 22 customers par 980 rupay ki prediction, aur chhatay din model ne 28 customers ke liye 1,220 kaha jabke asal 1,250 the. Logistic model parhai ke ghanton ko pass hone ke imkan mein badalta hai jo 0 ke qareeb se 1 ke qareeb tak S-shakal mein barhta aur fail aur pass students ke darmiyan 0.5 paar karta hai; banaya gaya curve wazahati hai. K = 2 ke saath K-means Basim, Umer aur Maliha ko Math 78.3, English 65 ke markaz par, aur Anie aur Tallat ko Math 45, English 82.5 par jama karta hai. Model masla tay karne, data jama karne, algorithm chunne, train karne aur naye data par jaanchne se banta hai.

blocks.prompt: Logistic regression linear regression se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Linear regression seedhi line par adad ki pesh-goi karta hai; logistic regression S-shakal curve par haan ya nahi nateeje ka imkan (0 se 1) batata hai.

items: Logistic regression: P = 1 / (1 + e^-(b0 + b1 x)) pass ka imkan 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan deta hai.
